title: Deploy the packaged build to a physical Quest 2: install, 72 Hz, tracking, input (split from T-0006)
acceptance: APK installs and launches on a Quest 2
72 Hz holds in the sandbox range and a stand-in level, no stale frames (device log / OVR metrics)
Both controllers track; triggers, grips and menu button work
description: Split from T-0006 by the owner on 2026-11-18: the game already installs and runs on a Quest 3 (72/72 FPS, CPU+GPU 11.8 ms, App 4 ms), and the Quest 2 is not available yet. The bible's floor is Quest 2 (P-31), so this check is still required before the M1 gate (T-0016).
